title: Signed to Fearless Records
detail: Per Taylor Foiles' November 2009 email to Alternative Press.

title: Songs in Tap Tap Revenge
detail: The February 2010 interview says a song was 'on Tap Tap Revenge 3', and the August 2010 interview questions name 'Duck Duck Grey Goose' and 'Do Not Disturb' as songs played on Tap Tap. The exact game version and release dates are not yet confirmed.

title: First festival: The Bamboozle
detail: Bamboozle 2010 was described by the band as their first real festival.

title: Fearless Back To School digital sampler
detail: The band was offered free inclusion on the label's Back To School digital sampler and chose 'We Don't Care'.

title: MTV: 'Ciroc and Roll' on The Challenge 21: Rivals
detail: Fearless's licensing director reported that the song aired in the show's episode with an on-screen credit.

title: Six compilation appearances
detail: Including Fearless Records Summer Samplers 2009 and 2010, a Japanese CD+DVD compilation and Atticus V.

title: Official music video for 'Duck Duck Grey Goose'
Official Fender artist page
detail: An official Fender artist page existed by May 2010 (artist id 314), alongside artist-priced Fender guitars and bass.

title: Alternative Press issue 249 (Hometown Heroes)
detail: Appeared in AP's AP&R section; AP later asked for follow-up quotes.
